action_pipeline.u_base_pre_safety: RobotLocalControllerOutput.base_action, the frozen Phase 6 pre-projection sum

clearance_sources.authority: the same threshold the frozen collision truth uses in SimulatorEpisodeSession._check_collisions
clearance_sources.distance_definition: swept minimum centre-to-centre distance over the closed control interval (_moving_point_min_distance)
centre-to-centre distance to the circle primitive
CorridorPrimitive.surface_distance -- Euclidean distance to wall material, zero inside it
swept minimum centre-to-centre distance to the moving circle over the control interval

clearance_sources_excluded.reason: the owner definition names exactly two constraint classes, robot-robot and robot-obstacle. Boundary exit remains a separate frozen termination and validity condition and is deliberately not folded into the clearance margin.

collision_tolerance_note: StaticWorld.collision_tolerance_meters (1e-9) is a numerical guard inside the collision predicate, not part of the frozen minimum admissible clearance, so it does not enter a slack

counterfactual_execution.other_robots: ordinary frozen local policies; never artificially frozen and never given coordinated joint candidate actions

K_zero_audit.structural_argument: a dense row exists only where the controller produced an action, and the frozen step() returns immediately once an episode has terminated, so no row can be at or after termination; restoring such an instant always executes at least one interval

evaluation.duration: the remainder of the existing frozen episode: normal frozen policies until the ordinary terminal state or the family horizon
evaluation.terminal_policy: collision, task failure, readiness failure and ordinary horizon termination are all scored over the actually executed trace; only execution-invalid candidates follow the frozen validity semantics

trace_sample_convention.K: the number of executed control intervals
trace_sample_convention.rule: post-step states only; the pre-step snapshot state is not a sample. Every per-step statistic in the frozen SimulatorEpisodeSession.step -- collision truth, progress, Metric V3 dwell, deadlock window and goal dwell -- is evaluated after the integration.

extends.relationship: V2 completes producer semantics around the unchanged V1 selector and target builder; V1 semantics are not mutated

h4_optionality.if_generation_is_operationally_infeasibl: disable or remove the residual branch under H4 optionality

candidate_action_construction_sources: Phase-6 local controller output derived from that view
local protocol/topology state legitimately available to robot i
local safety state/operator legitimately available to robot i
information_boundary.robot_local_information_only: certifies the provenance of the information used to construct the candidate action and its local admissibility; it makes no claim about the offline outcome oracle

intervention.after_the_interval: robot i resumes the normal frozen local publication policy

conditions: RobotLocalView required fields finite and valid
locally_feasible.definition: the candidate can be constructed and the one-interval intervention executed inside the local controller/dynamics domain

utility.consumed_by: the unchanged V1 selector and its frozen weights

fields.normalizer_authority: ego_graph_v2 feature 'local_progress_spacing' -- 'own history progress / nominal spacing'
fields.raw_source: RobotView.local_progress, assigned by SimulatorEpisodeSession._update_progress as the longitudinal progress of the fitted topology origin along the mission direction
fields.scalar_reducer: none required; the raw quantity is already scalar

fields.empty_set_audit: the smallest qualified team size is 5, so at least ten robot-robot pairs are always applicable regardless of geometry; no sentinel, fallback radius or synthetic obstacle is introduced
fields.normalizer: constraint-by-constraint: the corresponding frozen minimum admissible clearance
fields.normalizer_authority: the frozen collision truth; see clearance_sources
fields.raw_source: centralized simulator physical truth: every applicable robot-robot pair distance and robot-obstacle clearance
fields.scalar_reducer: minimum over applicable constraints at each trace sample, each normalized by its own frozen threshold
fields.sign_convention: positive above the frozen physical threshold, zero at it, negative is a violation

fields.M: the number of post-step trace samples; M == K
fields.normalizer_authority: the frozen geometric scale of the formation; the Phase-6 formation term and ego_graph_v2 'formation_residual_spacing' both normalize by it

normalizer_rejected.reason: Metric V3 epsilon_form is an acceptance/tube tolerance, not the geometric scale of the formation

fields.raw_source: the per-robot formation-error 2-vector, the Phase-6 mean pairwise residual over fresh nominal neighbours (robot_local_formation_term)
fields.temporal_reducer: root mean square over the trace samples

fields.normalizer: the Euclidean norm of the residual bound vector (bx, by)
fields.temporal_reducer: none; the quantity is fixed at candidate construction time
